name: SScribe Export Site Pages
author: simplixinnovations

sections.description:
Your whole WordPress site, as documents. Word, PDF, HTML and Markdown, in one ZIP.

SScribe Export Site Pages is a free WordPress export plugin by Simplix Innovations. It turns pages, posts and custom post types into Word (DOCX), PDF, HTML and Markdown files, in bulk and in every language, packed in one ZIP.

New in 3.0: rebuilt from the ground up. A new admin with live document previews, a new export engine that resumes where it stopped, templates, schedules and WP-CLI. Tested with 50,000 pages on ordinary shared hosting.

Why SScribe

  • Four formats, one click. Word, PDF, HTML and Markdown, together or one at a time.
  • The whole site, not one page. Bulk export pages, posts and custom post types by status and language.
  • Proven at scale. 50,000 pages in one run on shared hosting, with zero failed pages.
  • See it before you export. Preview the real documents, the ZIP contents, the time and the size.
  • Every language. WPML, Polylang and TranslatePress, with each document in its page’s language.
  • Arabic, done properly. True right-to-left layout and Arabic dates in every format.
  • Your brand on every page. Templates with your colours, logo, cover page, header and footer.
  • Runs on its own. Scheduled exports to a server folder, Amazon S3, Cloudflare R2 or Wasabi.
  • Private and free. Files stay on your server. No account, no ads, no upsell.

Export WordPress to Word (DOCX)

Give clients, editors and translators real Word documents with headings, tables, images and a table of contents. They open in Microsoft Word, Google Docs and LibreOffice.

Export WordPress pages and posts to PDF

Print-ready PDFs in A4, Letter, Legal or A3, with images, tables and page numbers. Made for sign-off, records and reading offline.

Convert WordPress to Markdown and HTML

Clean Markdown with front matter for Hugo, Jekyll, Astro and Obsidian, and styled HTML pages that keep their SEO tags. Every ZIP adds llms.txt for AI tools and knowledge bases.

Made for the people who need it

  • Agencies: hand a client the whole site for review and sign-off.
  • Translators: every page as an editable Word file, per language.
  • SEO and content teams: audit titles, descriptions and copy offline.
  • Site owners: a readable offline copy of every page, for records or a site move.
  • Records and compliance: dated archives with SHA-256 checksums and a signed manifest.
  • Developers: wp sscribe export for scripts, CI and the largest sites.

Works with

WPML, Polylang, TranslatePress, Yoast SEO, Rank Math, All in One SEO, SEOPress, The SEO Framework, Advanced Custom Fields, WooCommerce, Amazon S3, Cloudflare R2, Wasabi and WP-CLI.

Private by default

Archives stay in a protected folder on your server, download only for their owner, and are deleted after 72 hours. SScribe sends nothing to Simplix Innovations.

External services

SScribe does not connect to Simplix Innovations or to any service you have not set up yourself.

S3-compatible storage (optional): when an export has an S3 destination, the finished ZIP is uploaded over HTTPS, signed with the access key you enter, to the endpoint and bucket you enter, such as Amazon S3, Cloudflare R2 or Wasabi. Review your provider’s terms and privacy policy.

Images: during an export SScribe may fetch images through the WordPress HTTP API, by default only from your own site, so a Media Library file that cannot be read from disk can still be embedded. Developers can add hosts with the sscribe_allowed_image_hosts filter; requests send standard data such as your server’s IP address to that host.

Privacy

SScribe stores short-lived export sessions, page queues and security records in the database, and archives and logs in a protected uploads folder. Archives expire after 72 hours; sessions and logs are cleaned on a schedule. Security records hold an HMAC-protected form of the request IP address with the user ID, action, time and result. The plugin registers WordPress personal-data exporter and eraser callbacks. Uninstalling removes its settings, schedules, sessions, archives and logs.

License

GPL-2.0-or-later. Bundled PhpOffice/PhpWord (LGPL-3.0-only) and TCPDF 7.0.20 with its tc-lib dependencies (LGPL-3.0-or-later) are GPL-compatible under the GPLv3 option. PhpOffice/Math, PSR Container and the Phosphor icons use MIT; SScribe Sans, built from Google’s Noto fonts, uses the SIL Open Font License 1.1. Each notice ships beside its files.

Development

Canonical source repository: https://github.com/SimplixInnovations/sscribe-export-site-pages (private)

The tagged source of each WordPress.org release is accessible to reviewers. The plugin ships its full readable source, including admin/src/.

Report security issues privately to plugins@wordpress.org.

Required tools: PHP 8.2+, Composer 2.x, Node.js 24+, and Git.

Build from a clean checkout:

composer install
composer vendor:prefix
composer release

Build transformations are documented in docs/BUILD_TRANSFORMATIONS.md.
sections.installation:
Install

  1. In your WordPress admin, go to Plugins > Add New Plugin.
  2. Search for “SScribe Export Site Pages”, then click Install Now and Activate.
  3. Open SScribe Export in the admin menu.

Your first export, in about a minute

  1. Source content: choose Pages, Posts or All content types, then the status and language.
  2. Documents: tick Word, PDF, HTML or Markdown, or All four formats.
  3. Check: preview the documents, see the time and size, and open Export checks for any warnings.
  4. Export: click Export. You can close the tab; SScribe picks up where it stopped.
  5. Download: get the ZIP from the finished screen or from History. Archives are kept for 72 hours.

Make it yours

Add your logo and colours in Templates, automate exports in Schedules, or script them with wp sscribe export --formats=docx,pdf.

Requirements and tips

  • PHP 8.2+ with cURL, DOM, GD, XML, ZIP and Sodium (or OpenSSL with AES-256-GCM).
  • 256 MB of PHP memory is recommended for large PDF exports.
  • On nginx, block direct access to archives: location ~* /uploads/(sites/[0-9]+/)?sscribe-export-site-pages/ { deny all; }
  • Every export in History keeps its log. The Help tab and the support forum cover the rest.
sections.faq:
How do I export all WordPress pages to PDF?

Install SScribe, choose Pages and PDF, and click Export. You get one ZIP with a PDF for every page.

How do I convert WordPress posts to Word documents?

Choose Posts and Word (DOCX). Every post becomes an editable Word file with its headings, tables and images.

Does it work with WPML, Polylang and TranslatePress?

Yes. Export one language or all of them. Each document uses its page’s language for labels and dates.

Does it support Arabic and right-to-left languages?

Yes. Every format is laid out right to left with Arabic labels and dates, and the admin works in RTL.

How many pages can SScribe export?

Tested with 50,000 pages on shared hosting. Exports run in batches and resume after a reload; WP-CLI suits the very largest sites.

Can I export WordPress to Markdown for a static site or AI tools?

Yes. Markdown comes with front matter for Hugo, Jekyll, Astro or Obsidian, and every ZIP includes llms.txt.

Can exports run automatically?

Yes. Schedule them hourly, daily, weekly or monthly, export only what changed, and deliver them to a folder or S3.

Which scripts can PDF files show?

Latin, Greek, Cyrillic and Arabic-script text. SScribe warns you before a PDF needs another script, such as Chinese or Thai; use Word, HTML or Markdown for those pages.

Where are my files stored, and who can download them?

In a protected, randomly named folder inside uploads. Only the user who made an export can download it, through a single-use link, and archives are deleted after 72 hours. SScribe never sends your content anywhere you have not set up.
sections.changelog:
3.0.0

  • Rebuilt from the ground up: a new admin with document and ZIP previews, dark mode and right-to-left support.
  • Tested exports of up to 50,000 pages, with resumable archive building and ZIP64.
  • Document templates: Default, Minimal, Translation and your own.
  • WP-CLI and scheduled exports: incremental runs, one archive per language, delivery to a folder or S3-compatible storage.
  • manifest.json, INDEX.md and llms.txt in every archive; Markdown front matter presets.
  • ACF, WooCommerce and custom fields in every format; optional compliance mode with a signed manifest.
  • One bundled PDF font, smaller PDFs, and a warning for scripts it does not cover.
  • Each document uses its page’s language for labels, dates and page numbers.
